autopilot.access_forbidden_desc: Envato rejected the request before market mapping. Create a new personal token with “View and search Envato sites” and “View your Envato Account username” enabled, then run Test Connection again. If it still fails, check account access or network restrictions.
autopilot.advanced_after_discovery: Use this after Market Autopilot finds a direction that needs deeper validation.
autopilot.advanced_research_desc: Validate a catalog or product direction discovered by Market Autopilot with a focused keyword and page scope.
autopilot.comparable_history_desc: The direction is based on a compatible prior market map.
autopilot.composition_only_desc: A comparable historical map is required before the system can label the market as rising or falling.
autopilot.configure_token_first: Configure the Envato token in Settings first.
autopilot.first_run_desc: Configure the token in Settings, then map the observed market. The first map shows composition only; direction requires comparable history.
autopilot.generic_failure: The market map could not be completed. Review the safe technical details below.
autopilot.invalid_token_desc: Create or copy a valid personal token, then test the connection again.
autopilot.map_summary: Observed {{products}} products and {{authors}} public authors with {{coverage}} coverage.
autopilot.mapping_market_desc: The application is sampling official market surfaces and building normalized observations.
autopilot.market_autopilot_desc: Map the supported observed market first, then receive catalog trends, product directions, production insights, and saturation warnings before using Advanced Research.
autopilot.no_catalog_results: No catalog ranking is available yet.
autopilot.no_evidence_products: No evidence products are available for this direction.
autopilot.no_insights: No production insights are available yet.
autopilot.no_product_directions: No product directions are available yet.
autopilot.opens_original_new_tab: Opens the original product page in a new tab
autopilot.product_links_summary: {available} of {count} observed products have a verified source link.
autopilot.product_list_failed: The observed product list could not be loaded.
autopilot.rate_limited_desc: Envato temporarily limited the request rate. Wait briefly, use Quick mode, and try again. The application follows Retry-After and keeps the scan bounded.
autopilot.schedule_note: Weekly automation uses the headless market-map command so the token is never stored in the dashboard.
autopilot.service_unavailable_desc: The Envato service returned a server error. Your local market history was not replaced. Try again later.
autopilot.source_policy_desc: Official API only · bounded requests · no raw response retention.
autopilot.source_products_desc: These public product pages support this observed product direction. Opening a source does not change any Market Signal Lab score.
autopilot.source_settings_desc: Configure the personal token once for this application session. It remains only in memory and is never stored or exported.
autopilot.surface_denied_desc: The token passed the catalog-access check, but one or more optional market surfaces returned HTTP 403. The application now skips those surfaces and continues whenever usable observations remain.
autopilot.surface_denied_title: Some Envato catalog surfaces were denied
autopilot.token_permission_desc: The token can read Envato totals but cannot search the catalog. Create a new personal token with “View and search Envato sites” and “View your Envato Account username” enabled, then test the connection again.
autopilot.uses_settings_token: Uses the session token from Settings.
consensus.capture_companion_hint: Use the explicit browser companion on the active Envato page, then review the preview here.
consensus.capture_preview_desc: Review the normalized visible ranking before saving it to local history.
consensus.market_consensus_description: Compare ranking contexts, agreement, ambiguity, persistence, and volatility.
consensus.pair_not_comparable: Pair is stored for audit but is not comparable.
consensus.preview_expired: The capture preview expired or was already handled.

evidence.description: Inspect whether existing signals are justified, limited, or withheld by the C3 evidence contract.
evidence.narrative_movement_degraded: Early observed movement indication; evidence limitations apply.
evidence.narrative_suppressed: Directional signal withheld because required evidence is unavailable or incompatible.
evidence.run_id_required: Enter a completed market map Run ID before building evidence.
integrity.no_surface_data: No surface audit is available yet.
integrity.quality_no_warnings: No quality warnings for this audited run.
integrity.score_provenance_desc: Exact stored evidence, versions, weights, contributions, caps, and fallback rules for this score.
integrity.segment_explorer_desc: Global → Site → Content Type → Catalog → Product Type → Use Case.
integrity.signal_quality_desc: Separate market surfaces from catalogs, audit the sample, and show exactly why each score exists.
integrity.signal_quality_panel_desc: Sample balance, taxonomy confidence, historical depth, failures, caps, and reason codes.
integrity.surface_breakdown_desc: Market surfaces show where an item was observed; they are not catalogs.
integrity_ui.audit_summary: {observations} observations · {products} unique products · {completed}/{target} strata complete · {duplicate} duplicates
integrity_ui.composition_desc: One compatible run describes current composition only; no directional claim is made.
integrity_ui.established_desc: Six or more compatible runs support an established observed trend.
integrity_ui.integrity_desc: Separate market surfaces from catalogs, inspect sample quality, and trace every score to its stored evidence.
integrity_ui.integrity_load_failed: Signal-integrity data could not be loaded: {message}
integrity_ui.legacy_review_summary: Legacy classification reviews requiring traceable handling: {count}.
integrity_ui.movement_desc: Two compatible runs provide an early indication of movement.
integrity_ui.no_integrity_data: No signal-integrity data is available yet.
integrity_ui.no_segments: No eligible segmented market indices are available.
integrity_ui.preliminary_desc: Three to five compatible runs form a preliminary trend, still subject to quality gates.
integrity_ui.provenance_desc: This audit explains the evidence, model versions, weights, caps, missing components, and fallback rules behind the stored score.
integrity_ui.provenance_load_failed: Score provenance could not be loaded: {message}
integrity_ui.sample_audit_summary: {unique} unique products from {observations} observations · completed strata {strata} · author coverage {authors}.
integrity_ui.segment_explorer_desc: Global → Site → Content Type → Catalog → Product Type → Use Case. Market surfaces remain a separate evidence dimension.
integrity_ui.signal_quality_summary: Dominant site {site} · dominant catalog {catalog} · duplicates {duplicate} · taxonomy confidence {taxonomy} · surface diversity {surfaces}.
integrity_ui.stage_composition_desc: One comparable map is available. This is current composition only; no directional claim is published.
integrity_ui.stage_established_desc: Six or more compatible maps support an established observed trend.
integrity_ui.stage_movement_desc: Two compatible maps provide a movement indication. Confidence remains capped until more history exists.
integrity_ui.stage_preliminary_desc: Three to five compatible maps support a preliminary trend. Treat it as developing evidence, not a settled cycle.
integrity_ui.surface_breakdown_desc: New, Random New, Popular, Featured, Search, Category, and Similar are exposure surfaces—not catalogs.
recommendation.insufficient_evidence: Collect more comparable evidence before deciding.
recommendation.produce_candidate: Strong observed candidate for production validation.
recommendation.research_now: Run Advanced Research now to validate the opportunity.
scan_insight.cancelled: The scan was cancelled; preserved progress may still be reviewed as partial evidence.
scan_insight.failed: No reliable scan insight is available because the scan failed.
scan_insight.insufficient_history: The real observations were saved, but comparable history is still insufficient for a strong movement signal.
scan_insight.low_coverage: The scan completed, but coverage is too low for a confident market conclusion.
scan_insight.partial_scope: Only part of the configured research scope was observed; treat the result as an incomplete signal.
scan_insight.ranking_ready: A ranking snapshot is available for the updated observed universe.
scan_insight.running: The scan is still collecting bounded observations.
scan_insight.unknown: No deterministic scan insight is available.
scanner_summary.cancelled: Scan was cancelled and progress was preserved.
scanner_summary.failed: Scan failed before sufficient observations were collected.
scanner_summary.partial_budget: Scan stopped safely because the request budget was exhausted.
scanner_summary.partial_error: Scan saved partial observations after a connector error.
semantic.legacy_no_comparable_direction: Legacy v0.1 value; no comparable products are available for directional interpretation.
static.add_two_to_four_items: Add two to four items from an explorer table.
static.append_real_research_observations: Append real research observations with source, query, timestamp, sample size, reliability, and method.
static.author: Author
static.author_structure_desc: Public author identity is used only to understand market concentration, catalog participation, and competitive distribution.
static.build_a_ranking_from_real_observa: Build a ranking from real observations.
static.build_a_ranking_or_select_a_ranke: Build a ranking or select a ranked catalog.
static.build_an_auditable_observed_marke: Build an auditable Observed Market Universe, then compare how catalogs and products move across adjacent research windows. Trend and Opportunity remain separate signals.
static.catalog_path_research_query_resea: Catalog Path · Research Query · Research Session
static.compare_adjacent_7d_30d_or_90d_re: Compare adjacent 7D, 30D, or 90D research windows. A high Trend Score means attention is moving. Product Insight Score and Catalog Insight Score are composite observed-market ranking signals — not entry timing or success probability.
static.counts_and_research_scope_coverag: Counts and research-scope coverage only. This does not claim access to Envato's complete internal database.
static.coverage_describes_research_scope: Coverage describes this declared research scope, not the complete Envato database.
static.create_a_catalog_path_to_begin: Create a Catalog Path to begin.
static.enter_token_directly_in_app: Enter the token directly in this private app; never send it through chat.
static.envato_benchmark_stays_separate_f: Envato Benchmark stays separate from our independent engine so Agreement and Divergence remain inspectable.
static.explorer_watchlist_desc: Filter the observed market universe, compare entities, preserve reusable views, and monitor selected catalogs, products, or public-author market identities.
static.exposure_is_inferred_from_positio: Exposure is inferred from positions, cross-query presence, surface appearances, freshness, and rank movement in this research universe.
static.filter_local_data_desc: These controls query the local research database and versioned ranking snapshots. They do not perform a new market scan.
static.independent_opportunity_engine_pr: Independent Opportunity Engine · preserved from v0.2
static.latest_independent_market_opportu: Latest independent Market Opportunity values. They are not competitor earnings and are not yet calibrated success probabilities.
static.leave_blank_to_use_the_newest_sav: Leave blank to use the newest saved ranking.
static.legacy_v0_2_aggregate_evidence_qu: Legacy v0.2 aggregate evidence query. totalHitsExact remains visible in the response contract. Powered by Envato API when used.
static.manual_normalized_values_remain_a: Manual normalized values remain available. Evidence-based analysis is preferred.
static.market_signal_lab_is_an_independe: Market Signal Lab is an independent private research application and is not an official Envato product. Powered by Envato API when the optional official API connector is used. It analyzes public market structure, catalogs, products, and public author metadata to support quality competition—not hacking, private-data access, or idea theft.
static.name: Name
static.observed_exposure_score_not_an_en: Observed Exposure Score — not an Envato Boost Score.
static.observed_market_ranking_real_obse: Observed Market Ranking · real observations only
static.observed_trend_score_not_an_inter: Observed Trend Score — not an internal Envato score.
static.optional_official_api_lane_the_to: Optional official API lane. The token is ephemeral, cleared after request, and never returned or stored.
static.public_author_identity_is_used_on: Public author identity is used only to understand market structure and concentration—not personal profiling.
static.real_market_scanner_desc: Run a user-bounded official API research session across multiple keywords and pages. Results become normalized catalog, product, public-author, observation, and ranking evidence.
static.request_budget_note: Includes retry requests; the scan stops safely when the budget is exhausted.
static.research_is_user_initiated_catalo: Research is user-initiated, catalog-scoped, auditable, rate-limit aware, and request-budget bounded. Manual and CSV observations remain first-class.
static.scanner_coverage_warning: Coverage measures the bounded keyword/page scope configured above—not the complete Envato database. Run the same scope again over time to create comparable history.
static.source_names_unchanged: Product titles, public author names, search queries, URLs, IDs, and source metadata remain in their original source language.
static.stable_analytical_identity_plus_r: Stable analytical identity plus replaceable live display metadata. Freshness states: LIVE · FRESH · STALE — REFRESH REQUIRED · IMPORTED SNAPSHOT.
static.this_table_explains_what_has_been: this table explains what has been observed. Ranking above interprets movement without claiming complete market coverage.
static.token_never_stored: The token is sent only with this request, then cleared from the interface. It is never stored, exported, or written to application logs.
static.trend_measures_observed_movement_: Trend measures observed movement; it does not claim access to Envato's source code or private demand data.
static.v0_2_analysis_history_is_preserve: v0.2 analysis history is preserved. Market Memory and regime matching remain deferred to Subproject E.
static.watchlist_desc: Monitor selected local entities. Current labels and ranking metrics are resolved at read time.
telemetry.last_completed_explainer: These results reflect the last completed market map, not the live run above.
telemetry.plan_build_failed: Scan plan could not be built
telemetry.scan_terminal_error: Market mapping stopped with an error
telemetry.starting_live_run_desc: The run continues on the local server even if this browser tab refreshes.
temporal.never_seen_in_trend: Not yet observed in a qualifying trend
warning.proxy_only: Proxy-only Elements analysis: Confidence is capped at 60 until direct Elements evidence is added.
warning.stale_evidence: Some scoring evidence is older than 72 hours; confidence is freshness-capped.
analytics_engine.description: Go hosts the application. Rust is the mandatory production analytics runtime for migrated calculations. Python and C++ are future or conditional components.
